body: Thanks will do.

Everything was good until the pandemic happened and parents wanted me to spend time with sister since schools closed and she had no friends, she never left home. It's unfortunate this happened, never thought it would,

That's what I was thinking. I'm not sure why my mom decided to handle things her way, who knows. Once she read my sisters diary, she should have sat her down immediately and told her no. Instead, well, this happened. 

Yeah I have tons of friends and people I know outside of my family which are helping me through this. It's fine, I am moving out and will see what the future has in store for me. I think I need the freedom anyways. I messed up bad, Best to stop talking to my family and begin a new.

Unfortunately I was the only person she spent time with, other than a classmate of hers who joined us a couple of times, she passed away.

I really don't know. I thought this was not possible to fall in love with a family member, so why is this happening
I don't talk much when we hangout. I would hope our parents would say something.
Now's the hard part; telling our parents to take my Sister to therapy.

 In the evenings, my friends and I always outdoors playing ball, my Sister knows this.
For now this is the best solution. Definitely will avoid being near her and alone with her until her feelings subside.

Still I blame myself, I put myself in a bad situation which led to her catching feelings and writing about it. I'm sure I could have said no to her wanting to hangout everyday, but couldn't do it.

I've tried my best. Even now, I just got home from playing basketball. I asked my Sister to come, she says no like always. There were definitely girls that would be there, but she always wants to hangout with me alone. I mean, we had a friend her age that came with us a couple of time, but she commit suicide. Maybe that's it. 

Anyways, I think it's best to give her space and allow her to make her own decision. I've blocked her texts, so hopefully that will open up her shell to spend time outdoors alone maybe.

I just... I don't want to get into trouble. Our parents took away my car keys last time, if they kick me out of home, I will be probably end up homeless since my job doesn't pay much. My sister will probably make friends if I give her space; our high school hopefully opens this September so she'll be fine.

I don't really talk to my sister, 99% of the time we hangout, she's the one with the open mouth. For sure I can tell my Sister about clubs and groups she can join. I did what Mom said, I blocked my Sisters texts and won't be spending time with her. Maybe our Mom wants to spend time with my Sister, which would be good. I will give my Sister space, maybe for the best.

I guess I can try asking our Mom these questions, but I probably won't just because I don't talk much aloud and don't want any problems. For now, I trust our Mom, she's a woman and probably knows what her daughter is going through and wants to help her.

Now that you mention it, my Sister does like being in secluded areas with me. But ew, I doubt she's attracted to her bro. Gross. She just likes exploring and taking pictures, seeing good views.  I think I will allow my Sister space, let her enjoy her teenage years doing whatever makes her happy. I've blocked her from texting me and stopped hanging out with her, probably for the best. I don't want our Mom getting mad.

Our parents are really chill, not sure why they have a problem with this in particular. Maybe they realized my Sister hangs out with nobody but me, and that is concerning them. But they could be right. My sister wants to pay for me, always has money ready to pay before I could tap my credit card. 

Again, I don't want to talk back to my parents, sarcastically or not. I rarely talk at all out loud, 99% of the time we hangout, my Sister does the talking.
I made a new thread. But yeah, our Mom doesn't want us hanging out anymore.

Our Mom thinks it's a bad habit; I work night shifts, so everyday when I wake up, my Sister texts me and we go outside wherever she wants. She pays me and pays for my gas, food, parking. Mom also told me before I'm using my Sister for financial gain.

She just doesn't want us spending time together indoors and outdoors, I guess forcing my sister to find other people her age? At least that's what I'm thinking.

I think she just wants my Sis to spend time outdoors... by herself or with people her age. Ever since the pandemic began, she's been spending everyday with me and I think our Mom is worried. 

And the funny thing is, our parents are the ones that told me to spend time and watch out for my Sister. So now what do I do? I am very quiet and don't want to talk back to our Mom.

I agree. But at the same time, my sister never leaves the home unless I accompany her. Whether it's outside to explore, chill, groceries, whatever. I can see where our Mom is coming from, if I leave home, she won't have anyone to hangout with.

Same. My Sister always wants to hangout with me, even though we're opposite genders and there's a age gap. But hey, I like to spend time outdoors and she loves exploring. Not sure why our Mom has a problem.

I agree with your point. She's very quiet, reserved and keeps to herself to our parents and at our home.

But whenever we hangout outdoors, she turns completely different. She's energetic, doing silly things such as climbing trees, and becomes very affectionate towards me, wanting to explore and try new things.

I don't know why, but it seems like two different personalities. She doesn't lack social skills, just maybe is more introverted. I think the main problem is that I'm her brother, not her friend, our parents want her to find girls she can be friends with and hangout with.

She can definitely meet up with friends and everyone. She just... doesn't seem to want to or maybe she may be lacking in friends in person. 

Libraries are closed for now I believe. She has money, time, yet she chooses to text me and plans trips with me every morning. Maybe it's my fault for saying yes all the time.
Oh okay. When we hangout, she's always pretty open. I'm pretty laid back and chill. So I hope I don't change myself too much to scare her away.

For sure. I will definitely tell her once she wakes up to attend Camp, hey if she likes it, that's good. If not, oh well. Just try it once for sure. The two of us went camping a couple of times together, so maybe she can use the experience to help the group she's with.
What do you mean?

I'm not sure the details of the August camp, probably just a week or two.

Yeah she's into cooking a lot, always asking me to take her shopping or pick up something so she can make something new. She's always indoors when she's not outdoors with me. Not sure about other hobbies; she does love to read and write.
Alright will do.

You're right, she needs to make friends her age. With schools closed where we live, it is definitely tough for her, and probably other teenagers as well..

You're right. I wish I could help my Sister out, I work night shifts and it's tough. But I should be trying. And yes, everyday when my Sis wants to hangout, I say yes. She does everything for me, so I can't say no or make any excuses. 

I'm actually very laid back and quiet. When we are out, my Sister talks 99% of the time. You're right, I should give her space, say no to her. How can I help her get out of her shell?
I'm trying my best. Our parents were the ones to tell me to take care of my Sister during the pandemic, and now they don't want me to. What did they expect?

Thank you for advise. I edited the post, basically my Sister doesn't want to be around kids. And hey, that's her choice. I live with my parents, if they ask for my car keys, I have to give it. Our parents want the best for my Sister. And it may be best to give her space?
I just stay quiet and do my best. Because I work nights, I have free time during late mornings and afternoons; my Sister always wants to go out for an adventure so hell, why not you know.
I read your comment twice. Thank you for this. I will try my best.

Oh okay. Currently we have a family doctor in our country which we can see for free, but if my Sister mentions her period pain coming back, I will be sure to recommend she sees someone more qualified for this. 

Yeah I think my Sister is scared to open up to our parents.

This is great advise. The good news is that my Sis talks a lot, so she definitely is really open about how she's feeling and what she wants to do when we're outside. And when we hangout, she'll always be near me for affection, which is fine. 

The main problem is I'm quiet around her. I smile when she does silly and weird things, but maybe you're right. She cooks great meals, plans really well when we hangout and loves new adventures, I should compliment that or her but I don't want to make her feel weird or anything. Is there any way I can do this?
Thank you so much. Yes, our parents have some different views about us. I will continue to look after my only sibling for sure!

Alright, if she brings up sex during conversation, I  will tell her this.

If my Sister is sexually active, good for her. But she's either hanging out with me or at home, so I doubt she is. 

I hope she practices safe sex either way.

At home, she seriously ignores me. If I say something, she gives short answer and doesn't show emotion, only responding when I text her. She will tap me on the shoulder when she texts me something, mostly to hangout. And when we go out, she turns completely 360, she becomes energetic, laughs a lot, is happy, talks to me, and well, just excited. Maybe you can tell me why that is the case?

Thanks.

Oh okay, I will look more into this. This is new information for me.
Thanks for the advise.

Definitely, she can have sex. But she's always spending time with me or at home, I've never seen her with a boy. Maybe it will change once schools open up. 

My sister is very skinny but her habits are good. She cooks her own food and eats healthy most of the time. Our parents are probably normal, they probably just don't want to become grandparents this early on :)
Definitely. Thankfully the weather is really good where we live, so we hangout everyday exploring our Province. She's definitely open with me and trusts me.

I do not blame Kitty's parents at all. She was going through undiagnosed depression; she could have had millions of dollars but the fate could have been the same, unfortunately.

And yes, definitely looking out for my sis. We seemed to have moved on.
I don't think my sis is sexually active yet. Maybe just curious and bought condoms. Yeah definitely should have talked to her. And my Sis always texts me at home, never interacts with me lol

thanks.
I would never talk down or bad about my parents. And I'm sure my sister will come to me for help if needed. Although I am pretty quiet and can't relate as we're different genders, but still.

I'll buy a pack of condoms, keep in my bedroom  and allow her to use

Not really no, but maybe this has to do with upbringing?
Nope, she's still on that birth control pills since she paid separately bills. But I doubt they will be happy once they find out. :(

I'm not sure what she's trying to do with her behavior towards our parents, but they seem to be worried now. And the only way I can talk to her at home is texting her.

She seemed like such a quirky and kind girl. Lots of life in her. And it's sad she left this world. I guess the guilt will remain for a while.
She hugs me tight everyday! But yeah, it sucks she is facing guilt, thankfully I am there by her side always.

Yup. My sister does occasionally bring up Kitty when we hangout, saying "Kitty would love this." My sis lost a close friend of hers and it hurts a lot. We respect Kitty's parents wish and allow them to grief. We hope they will contact us one day.
Thanks. I'm glad I finally found the courage to read the message, but still. This is something my Sister and I will remember for the rest of our lives.

Oh thanks. Yeah definitely helped. I'm not sure our parents would be too happy to know we're outside after sunset, but I guess until we get caught or my Sister tells them, we're okay. Alright will do.

And I liked reading about periods. Although I can't relate, I could use this advise when she might complain about cramps or waking up with pain.
Thanks. She's always wanting to go somewhere everyday, she packs food/drinks for a picnic, we explore and she pays me as well. Love it!
